ai_study_plan.strategy: This week's plan prioritizes foundational skills in math and reading, starting with the weakest areas first while maintaining balance. We will focus on building confidence and familiarity with question types through targeted practice and review.

days.detail: Complete 1 reading passage with 5 questions, focusing on main idea and detail retrieval.
Work through 10 math problems covering algebra and geometry with a focus on problem-solving strategies.
Review 10 SAT vocabulary words and practice using them in context with reading passages.
Complete 5 data interpretation questions using charts and graphs.
Review key concepts from the week, focusing on areas of confusion and reinforcing understanding.
Complete a full SAT practice set (10 reading, 10 math) with a focus on time management and accuracy.
Review all mistakes from the practice set, analyze patterns, and create a plan for improvement.

ai_study_plan.weekly_focus: Build foundational skills in reading and math through targeted practice and review, with a focus on improving accuracy and time management.
